value.rationale: A single physically meaningful adjustable confidence radius in a standard five-agent ℓ1-ball HK model generates every odd period beyond one without redesigning the fixed anchor geometry. Explicit exact disjoint radius windows, geometrically shrinking widths, and the period-return contraction quantify parameter sensitivity and connect heterogeneous HK models to mode-locking theory. This is a natural structural bifurcation family, not a one-off example or routine parameter replacement.
